jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

At Sentry, our Mobile team builds the next generation of observability tools for developers worldwide — processing over a billion events every single day. We're looking for a technical Senior Product Manager, Mobile to bring clarity and context to the team and help us create a delightful Sentry experience for mobile developers across the globe.

At Sentry, product managers, engineers, and engineering managers work together to help shape the roadmap and decide what to build next – with the engineering manager ultimately owning the decision. Your role will be to make sure the team deeply understands its users, the market, and how the product performs in the real world, including where it delights and where it creates friction, so the right decisions happen naturally. This position reports to the Director of Engineering..




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Turn scattered signal into clear context: Build and run a system that continuously gathers insight from everywhere it lives — users, customers, GitHub, our own product data, and the wider market (competitors, ecosystem trends, and industry shifts) — and turn it into well-framed problems, opportunities, and tradeoffs that inform the Mobile roadmap and guide prioritization. Draw out the people closest to customers (Sales, Support, Solutions) who are often acutely aware of the features we're missing, especially the ones about to cause customer churn

 - Be the developer's voice: Talk to developers and engineering leaders on a steady cadence, represent them when internal decisions get made, test ideas quickly and cheaply before committing engineering, and use what you learn to keep us aligned on the top priorities for this persona

 - Elevate the end-to-end mobile developer experience: Together with the Engineering Manager & Mobile engineers you will influence and improve the full user journey, from catching and surfacing a mobile issue in Sentry to resolving it automatically — across native (iOS, Android) and cross-platform (React Native, Flutter, KMP) developers alike

 - Connect the dots and build trust: Partner closely not just with the engineering team, but also various internal stakeholders across the company — earning trust over time by delivering on your commitments and communicating clearly with people inside and outside the company

 - Use AI to go faster and deeper: Apply strong judgment about where AI adds real leverage in discovery, synthesis, and analysis, and build it into repeatable systems rather than one-off prompts

 - Measure outcomes, not output: Commit to measurable objectives tied to real customer and business value, track the metrics that matter across usage and revenue, and turn what you see into hypotheses and action




YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Are relentlessly curious about users: you love talking to developers and customers, digging into data, structuring what you learn, and turning it into sharp hypotheses, problems, and bets

 - Genuinely care about developer experience: you love mobile platforms and sweat the details of a great end-to-end UX

 - Are technical enough to earn developers' trust: you know how software gets built, because you built or still build mobile applications yourself

 - Are a high-agency self-starter who organizes their own work: you don't wait to be told what to do — you find the problems that matter and bring them to a solution

 - Lead through context & collaboration, not control: energized by making a team smarter and letting them own priorities, rather than dictating the roadmap yourself




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years experience as a Mobile developer — you don’t solely rely on empathy when representing this persona, but speak from your own experience as well

 - 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally with B2B SaaS and observability products for mobile platforms — backed by a background in mobile software engineering (Apple, Android, React Native, Flutter, etc.)

 - Experience talking to customers directly and running continuous product discovery — you let evidence, not opinion, shape decisions

 - Strong business and product judgment with an affinity for data and metrics — you turn signals into clear hypotheses and actions

 - Excellent written and spoken communication, and a track record of driving outcomes through influence rather than authority — building alignment with engineering teams and business stakeholders through evidence and a clear narrative

 - Fluent with AI in your daily workflow — you use it to work faster and sharper across your PM craft, and know where it doesn't help

 - You live in the Vienna area or are willing to relocate



Not sure if you meet 100% of the qualifications? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're interested in people who are excited about this opportunity and eager to grow.



We are obliged by law to quote the minimum wage of EUR €64,554,-- gross per year for this position, in accordance with the respective collective agreement (IT-KV). 

A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits https://sentry.io/careers/ for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AT SENTRY

Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. That starts with making our industry accessible.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations@sentry.io.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry’s AI capabilities span infrastructure, product features, design, and data ingestion. We’re hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to connect this work across teams, helping them make decisions, manage dependencies, and deliver a cohesive product experience.



Our AI/ML team is building a modular platform for model routing, agent execution, and evaluations. Issues Platform owns customer-facing experiences such as issue details, activity feeds, and notifications. Product Design shapes how these experiences work together, while Ingest provides the underlying data pipeline.



You’ll lead the program across these teams: clarifying ownership, sequencing work, managing integration risks, and coordinating release readiness. You’ll partner with team leads to connect their plans and resolve gaps between roadmaps.



You’ll also improve how engineering changes reach teams across Engineering, Product, and Design, along with Documentation and Support. Your goal is a lightweight process giving partners the information and preparation time they need before changes reach customers.



You’ll join an early TPM team and help shape how the function works at Sentry. Success means helping teams deliver together through technical judgment, clear communication, and practical coordination.

This role is based in San Francisco, with three days per week in the office. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO


AI DELIVERY

 - Connect roadmaps across AI/ML, Issues Platform, Product Design, and Ingest into a shared delivery plan.

 - Sequence platform capabilities, product features, and design work so teams address dependencies before they delay a release.

 - Help teams assign accountable owners, resolve open decisions, and communicate commitments.

 - Partner with engineering and product owners to define release readiness, including evaluation results, staged rollouts, eligibility, and access requirements.

 - Bring ingestion and reliability dependencies into roadmap discussions so teams understand the risks behind delivery commitments.

 - Drive risk mitigation with clear owners, contingency plans, and timely escalation.

 - Give teams and leadership an accurate view of progress, dependencies, decisions, and risks.


CHANGE READINESS

 - Build a lightweight process for identifying changes affecting other teams, notifying partners, and confirming readiness before release.

 - Include documentation and support preparation in delivery planning, starting with AI features.

 - Establish concise updates showing what is changing, when, and who needs to act.

 - Review communication and readiness gaps with the teams involved, then improve the process.

 - Keep the effort proportional to the change and remove steps which don’t improve delivery.




HOW YOU WORK

 - You help teams bring structure to complex programs with unclear ownership or no established process.

 - You listen to different perspectives, make tradeoffs visible, and help teams resolve competing priorities.

 - You engage with technical details and connect architectural decisions to delivery risks and product outcomes.

 - You raise risks early, propose practical responses, and follow through.

 - You adapt processes to teams’ needs and simplify them when the value is unclear.

 - You respect team ownership while helping cross-team decisions reach resolution.

 - You share information clearly so partners have the context they need to contribute.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience leading complex technical programs from problem definition through launch.

 - Experience coordinating delivery across multiple engineering teams with separate roadmaps and leadership.

 - Technical understanding to review design proposals, discuss architectural tradeoffs with engineers, and identify integration risks and downstream effects.

 - A track record of managing dependencies, driving risk mitigation, and adapting plans as conditions change.

 - Experience creating or improving processes which teams adopted and sustained.

 - Clear written communication, including program updates, decision records, and escalations with explicit next steps.

 - Experience building alignment across engineering, product, and design through sound judgment and follow-through.

Relevant experience might come from technical program management, software engineering, or another role involving ownership of cross-team technical delivery.




PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Shipping AI/ML or LLM-backed features, including evaluations, quality checks, and staged rollouts.

 - Partnering with product design to coordinate design and engineering work.

 - Working with data pipelines, ingestion, or streaming infrastructure.

 - Building developer tools or technical B2B products.

 - Improving release communication across engineering, documentation, and support.

Experience in every preferred area is not required.




TEAM PRINCIPLES

 - Make work visible. Keep plans, ownership, decisions, and next steps clear and current.

 - Raise risks early. Give teams time to respond before delivery is affected.

 - Reduce friction. Build practices which help teams get work done.

 - Respect ownership. Support informed decisions and help accountable owners resolve open questions.

 - Keep partners informed. Communicate changes to scope, timing, and readiness before they affect others.



The base salary range Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $150,000 to $240,000 USD. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.
